explication: Vibe Notch is a macOS menu-bar app that monitors Claude Code sessions and presents their activity in a Dynamic Island-style notch. Claude Code hooks send events over a Unix socket; the app tracks session state and parses conversation files, then displays sessions and chat history. Users can approve or reject tool requests from the notch, with tmux operations carrying those actions to the terminal. The map follows documented wiring and SOURCE INDEX references; several UI and integration details are unsampled, so uncertain links are omitted.
